title: Creamy Spinach and Feta Pasta
description: A delightful Italian-inspired dish featuring tender pasta coated in a creamy sauce with fresh spinach and tangy feta cheese. Perfect for a comforting yet quick weeknight dinner.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
While the pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Add the crumbled feta cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing it in the creamy sauce. If needed, add reserved pasta water a little at a time to achieve desired sauce consistency.
Squeeze the juice of one lemon over the pasta and mix well. Adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed.
Serve the pasta garnished with grated parmesan, red pepper flakes, and fresh basil leaves if desired.

title: Spicy Chickpea Tacos
description: Delicious and easy-to-make vegan spicy chickpea tacos perfect for a quick weeknight lunch. Packed with flavor and nutrients, this dish combines spicy chickpeas with creamy avocado and fresh toppings.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas under cold water.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chickpeas, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Sauté for 5 minutes until the chickpeas are heated through and coated with spices.
While the chickpeas are cooking, dice the red onion and slice the avocado. Set aside.
Warm the taco shells in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for 2-3 minutes or until crisp.
Assemble the tacos by filling each shell with spicy chickpeas, avocado slices, and diced red onion.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice before serving.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Chinese-inspired chicken stir-fry with a delicious honey garlic glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

steps.instruction: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Set aside.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, slice the red bell pepper into strips, and julienne the carrot. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
In a small bowl, mix the honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and cornstarch until smooth. Set aside.

Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and season with black pepper. Stir-fry until the chicken is cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil and sesame oil. Add the garlic and ginger, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the broccoli, red bell pepper, and carrot to the pan. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return the chicken to the pan. Pour the honey garlic sauce over the chicken and vegetables, stirring to coat everything evenly. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with sliced green onions before serving, if desired.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: A classic Thai dessert featuring sweet sticky rice paired with ripe mango slices, all infused with creamy coconut milk.

steps.instruction: Rinse the glutinous rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Soak the rinsed rice in cold water for at least 30 minutes, preferably 1 hour.
Drain the soaked rice and steam it using a rice cooker or a steamer basket over boiling water for 20-25 minutes until tender.
In a saucepan, combine 1 cup of coconut milk, sugar, and salt. Heat gently over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Do not let it boil.
Once the rice is cooked, transfer it to a bowl and pour the sweetened coconut milk over it. Stir to combine. Cover and let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Peel and slice the mangoes. Set aside.
Dry roast the sesame seeds in a small pan over low heat until golden. Set aside.
Reserve 1/2 cup of coconut milk for drizzling. Warm it slightly if desired.
To serve, place a portion of sticky rice on a plate, top with mango slices, drizzle with reserved coconut milk, and sprinkle with roasted sesame seeds.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: A refreshing and hearty salad featuring quinoa and classic Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a light lunch.

steps.instruction: Rinse the quinoa under cold water to remove any bitterness.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the rinsed quinoa, reduce heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 15 minutes or until the quinoa is fluffy and water is absorbed.
While the quinoa is cooking, chop the cherry tomatoes in half and dice the cucumber and red onion finely.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, feta, and kalamata olives.
Add chopped parsley if using, and mix well to combine all ingredients evenly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, juice of the lemon, table salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat all ingredients.
Serve the salad immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving for enhanced flavors.

title: Beef Kofta Kebabs
description: Juicy and flavorful beef kofta kebabs seasoned with spices and herbs, perfect for a Middle Eastern-inspired dinner.

steps.instruction: Finely chop the yellow onion and parsley. Mince the garlic cloves.

In a large bowl, combine ground beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped parsley, cumin, coriander, paprika, cayenne pepper, table salt, and black pepper. Mix well until all ingredients are evenly incorporated.

Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions. Shape each portion into an oval or log shape, approximately 4 inches long, and thread onto skewers. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes beforehand to prevent burning.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Brush the koftas with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the koftas for about 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and have a nice char on the outside.
Remove the koftas from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over them before serving.

title: Classic French Onion Soup
description: A rich and savory French onion soup topped with melted cheese and crusty bread.

steps.instruction: Peel and thinly slice the yellow onions. Mince the garlic cloves.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized, about 25 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another 2 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and add the balsamic vinegar, bay leaves, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
While the soup is simmering, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice the baguette into 1-inch thick slices and toast them in the oven for about 5 minutes or until golden brown.
Grate the Gruyere cheese.
Remove the bay leaves from the soup. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls, place a slice of toasted baguette on top, and sprinkle generously with Gruyere cheese.
Place the bowls on a baking sheet and broil in the oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly, about 3-5 minutes.

title: Lentil Soup with Spinach
description: A hearty and nutritious Indian-inspired lentil soup featuring spinach and coconut milk, perfect for a healthy vegan lunch.

steps.instruction: Rinse the lentils under cold water until the water runs clear, then set aside.
Finely chop the yellow onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot. Sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in cumin, turmeric, coriander, and optional red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add the rinsed lentils and vegetable broth to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the coconut milk and spinach to the soup. Stir until the spinach is wilted, about 3 minutes.
Season the soup with table salt and black pepper to taste. Squeeze the juice of one lemon into the soup for added flavor.
Serve hot, garnished with optional chopped cilantro for a fresh finish.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
description: A moist and delicious banana bread loaded with chocolate chips, perfect for a snack or dessert.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas with a fork until smooth.
Melt the butter in a microwave or on the stove and let it cool slightly.
Add melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla extract to the mashed bananas. Mix well until combined.
In another bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture, stirring until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Fold in the chocolate chips gently.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan, spreading it evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the bread cool in the pan for about 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: A classic Thai dish featuring stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, vegetables, and a savory-sweet sauce.

steps.instruction: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for about 10 minutes until they are soft but not mushy. Drain and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the shrimp and cook until pink and opaque, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add another tablespoon of vegetable oil. Crack the eggs into the pan and scramble them until fully cooked. Remove and set aside with the shrimp.
Add the remaining oil to the pan. Sauté the minced garlic and sliced red bell pepper for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and the pepper is tender.
Add the drained noodles to the pan along with the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and lime juice. Toss to combine and cook for another 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp and scrambled eggs to the pan. Add the bean sprouts and chopped green onions. Toss everything together and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the Pad Thai hot, garnished with chopped peanuts, fresh coriander, and a sprinkle of chili powder if using.
